title: Close out gvc: retro, then flesh out the next feasible epic
description:
Run the epic-close retro, verifying the code against gvc's acceptance outside-in. Then pick the next feasible epic in soft order and partition it into child ticks including its own EPIC-SKELETON pair.

Specific to this epic: gvc is the first epic that can absorb its own findings, so the retro should report whether it DID - what it absorbed, against which item, observed or predicted - and that report is itself the first test of jlv's reporting. An epic about absorption that absorbed nothing and cannot say so has not been demonstrated.
notes: 2026-09-27 01:46 - ticfac run epic-gvc: 9xp try 1 (run dispatch #14) merged into epic/gvc as 164b518cdff7; the integrated gate (go, ts) passed.
acceptance_criteria: The retro verifies gvc's definition of done item by item against the code, reports what this epic absorbed with item ids and observed-or-predicted status, and the next feasible epic has child ticks and a skeleton
